This is a Gambler's Ruin problem with p = 2/3, q = 1/3.

The probability of reaching N before 0, starting from i, when p ≠ q:

P(i) = (1 - (q/p)^i) / (1 - (q/p)^N)

Here q/p = (1/3)/(2/3) = 1/2, N = 6, i = 3.

P(3) = (1 - (1/2)^3) / (1 - (1/2)^6)
     = (1 - 1/8) / (1 - 1/64)
     = (7/8) / (63/64)
     = (7/8) × (64/63)
     = (7 × 64) / (8 × 63)
     = 448 / 504
     = 8/9

Final answer: 8/9
